items.title: Online ‘rent a boyfriend’ ads are a scam, Hyderabad police warn women
items.summary: Follow TNM's WhatsApp channel for news updates and story links. The Hyderabad police have cautioned women to be wary of an online scam that offers a ‘fake boyfriend’ on ‘rent’, charging money for coffee dates, movie dates, accompanying for shopping, events, etc. Hyderabad Commissioner of Police VC Sajjanar said that this was a new ‘dating trap’ set by cyber fraudsters. The Commissioner said that posters were being circulated on Instagram, Telegram, and Facebook, featuring discount packages with captions such as "1st August Special - 50% OFF" and "Rent-a-Boyfriend – Your Personal Companion." He shared an example of one such poster, which listed charges from Rs 499 for a coffee date to Rs 4,499 to hire a person to pretend to be a boyfriend for an entire day. “Displaying photos of attractive young men, the scammers present a detailed price list: Rs 499 for a one-hour coffee meeting, Rs 1,249 for a movie date, Rs 1,499 for a shopping companion, Rs 1,999 to accompany you to events or weddings, and Rs 4,499 for a full 10-hour package.
